design:
## Design tests

After the bench, the new drawings and revision 30 were read blind in whole test scenes among other events (`vision/design_tests_v032.md`, six pictures, six readers). In both seesaw pictures the girl stuck up high is read holding the handle (she "sits high up on the raised left end, holding the handle"), and the man on the low end drew his remark in one of his two, as the bench said he would. Neither jumper reads as reaching for the thing stuck in a tree: "he is far from the tree and there is nothing above him". No box carried floats, and the hose and the can watering under a clear sky drew nothing on the sky. No reading called for a new rule.
intro:
The twenty-ninth screen read all 68 pictures, the set's 21 and 47 probes: 769 of 776 scored items had full marks, and one was misread. The girl stuck up high reads as holding the handle in all three of her pictures, no box carried on the forearm floats, and in the 12 pictures with watering no reader remarks on the sky. `jump`, last release's one failure, reads in full with the jumper kept clear of the tree. 63 of 64 templates pass, as in v0.31. The one failure, `blocked_hose` (0.83), is three items of one picture, the tier-4 garden, identical to the pixel to v0.31's, where they had full marks.

The screen says less than it seems to, again. On the 19 pictures identical in both screens, 242 of 246 items scored the same, and the four that moved all went down: the gate's failure and a begging dog's half mark. So the set's fall from 0.998 to 0.986 is mostly the readers. Of the rest, one item is a picture's own fault: a woman pointing up at storm clouds from right under a cat on the fence was read as "pointing upward at the cat".
screen:
Across all 68 pictures 769 of 776 scored items had full marks. Seven were under full marks, six of them in the set, and one was misread: the dog on the hose in the tier-4 garden, where the reader saw "a drop of water at the tip" and a dog that "might get sprayed". The three scorers gave one, three and three items under full marks, in 244, 288 and 244. The set's headline is all items 0.986 (0.998 in v0.31), with things at 0.991, actions at 0.988, inferences at 0.956 and contradictions at 1.00.

**A third retest.** 19 pictures, 17 of the set's and two probes, were identical to the pixel in v0.31 and v0.32. 242 of their 246 items scored the same, and the four that moved all went down: three on the dog on the hose, the gate's one failure, and the begging dog's inference. Two releases running, the template that failed did so on a picture that had not changed.

**Remarks were 3.28 a picture, 223 on 68 pictures**, from 2.71 to 4.43 a reader, as low as v0.31's readers. On the 19 identical pictures they fell from 79 to 67. Neither the remarks nor the scorers' oddity row (0.8 a picture in the set) says much about the drawings, so the changes are read picture by picture: the girl "holding the handle" in all three of her pictures, the box "in both arms", and no remark on a sky over watering.
redrawn: `seesaw_heavy` holds at 1.00 with the handle raised, and `seesaw` at 1.00, its two children of a size as before (the handle rises there only for a child up high with a teenager). `carry_box` holds at 1.00 on the forearm, and the hose and the can at 1.00 under a clear sky. `jump` is back to 1.00 with the jumper clear of the tree. `blocked_hose`, not redrawn, is the one failure, on a picture that came back unchanged.
gate: Every template was screened in at least three pictures (53 in three, 2 in four, 6 in five, 2 in six and one in nine), and 63 of 64 pass, as in v0.31. The failure is three items of one picture identical to v0.31's, where they had full marks: the retest's moves downward, as `jump`'s was last time. Its two other pictures, a goat and a dog on the hose, read in full. The gate is a filter, and the pilot with people is the test of difficulty.
inspection: The garden, park and playground tier-4 cells placed on v0.31's seeds, their pictures unchanged. The street's did not, with watering under a clear sky only and the jumper kept clear of the ball in the tree, and 38 more seeds failed; v0.29 to v0.31's template set, forced on the same seed, placed in 12 s. The tier-3 garden came from a seed search past its showcase seed. The five isomorphs came back identical to v0.31's, and the tier-4 one took 12 failed attempts. The first probe pass left `walk_dog` and `dog_begs` short, and one more probe filled both. All 68 records rebuild identical to the pixel, and the library passes the validator in full, 347 of 347, now that it reads a split rider's pieces.
calib: Nothing moved: no field by 0.002 or more, so the priors are v0.31's.
